roles.semanticIntent: Low-burden local escort, interception and short-range security combatant.
Sustained escort, patrol and reconnaissance combatant; dedicated Stage-22 physical endurance authoring remains downstream.
Fleet screen and strike-defense combatant with explicit physical fit and production validation.
Independent multi-role command combatant able to sustain missions away from immediate support.
Capital line and firepower asset whose burden is expressed through physical production and support.
Aviation and small-craft projection family with support burden separate from direct line combat.
General and bulk physical cargo movement for industrial and deployed-fleet supply chains.
Reaction-mass, stores and replenishment support for sustained deployed operations.
Industrial fleet support family covering logistics, repair and salvage authoring; later packages may split legal fits without changing the role contract.

missionProfiles.objective: Protect local traffic, intercept limited threats and maintain short-range security coverage.
Maintain sustained escort and patrol presence while operating on actor-bounded knowledge.
Screen a fleet, defeat strike threats and preserve the protected force rather than maximize raw damage.
Conduct independent multi-role operations with command, sensing and combat responsibilities.
Provide capital line firepower where infrastructure and support can sustain the commitment.
Project small-craft capability while preserving carrier and replenishment dependencies.
Move finite physical cargo between lawful supply and demand endpoints.
Sustain deployed fleet endurance through finite replenishment rather than hidden resupply.
Support repair, recovery and salvage using finite industry/freight authorities.

localizationRules.namingRule: Stable IDs remain language-neutral; Russian is source copy and English is a localization projection. Role and class names never alter simulation identity.
